title: Whether Bechet was imitated in Chicago
summary: Chace thinks Mezz Mezzrow worshipped Bechet, but neither finds Bechet in his playing.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Sidney Bechet: the man, the horn, the legend

blocks.x: Not to my knowledge. Of course, the name Mesrose springs to mind immediately, and I think he probably worshipped Bechet. Still does.
Yet I wouldn't say in his playing there's a bravery.
I can't find any, no, that's right.
